assertions.description: weight_load phase is present in the timeline
weight-load storage READ does not trigger checkpoint corroboration (TC-82b)

description: This scenario demonstrates the network fabric behaving normally during a GPU training run, establishing the healthy baseline against which all other fabric scenarios are compared. The training job progresses through its standard phases — loading weights from storage, running compute, and exchanging gradients between nodes — without any injected stressors, and all network performance metrics stay within their expected bounds. Control commands reach their destinations well within the latency budget, and storage reads during the weight-loading phase do not trigger any anomaly alerts. This matters because operators and investors need to see what a clean, healthy network looks like on the platform before evaluating how it responds to faults; this is the reference state for all subsequent comparison.
